research_metadata.coverage_notes: Rasuwa is a remote mountainous district in Bagmati Province with very limited higher education infrastructure. Most students travel to Kathmandu or Nuwakot for higher education. The primary higher education institution located directly within Rasuwa district is Rasuwa Multiple Campus.

identity.name: Rasuwa Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: Rasuwa Multiple Campus is a community-based campus located in Dhunche, Rasuwa district, affiliated with Tribhuvan University.
identity.description: Rasuwa Multiple Campus is the leading higher education institution in the Rasuwa district of Bagmati Province. Established to provide accessible higher education to the local mountainous community, it offers programs primarily in education and humanities under the affiliation of Tribhuvan University.

faq.answer: Rasuwa Multiple Campus is affiliated with Tribhuvan University.

faq.question: Where is Rasuwa Multiple Campus located?
faq.answer: It is located in Dhunche, Gosainkunda Rural Municipality, Rasuwa District, Bagmati Province, Nepal.

verification.notes: Rasuwa is extremely remote and has very few higher education options. Rasuwa Multiple Campus is the main recognized campus operating in the district.

research_gaps: Lack of online presence and official websites for institutions in Rasuwa district
Limited technical or vocational higher education institutes directly operating in the district beyond short-term CTEVT-affiliated skill trainings
